response.name: Evidence Synthesis
response.description: Search configured academic sources, extract claims and supporting evidence, build an evidence map, verify grounding, and export a synthesis report.

steps.name: Multi-Source Search
steps.description: Search configured academic databases for documents related to the research query.

steps.name: Claim and Evidence Extraction
steps.description: Extract individual claims and their supporting evidence from each retrieved document.
steps.system_prompt_template: Return exactly {"records":[{"source_id":"<UUID>","part_id":"p0001","claims":[{"claim_text":"Treatment reduced the measured score","quote":"The measured score decreased after treatment","confidence":0.9,"page_reference":null}]}]}. Include only claims supported by an exact source-substring quote. Confidence must be finite and from 0 to 1. Set page_reference to null unless trusted source metadata supplied a page locator.

steps.name: Evidence Map Construction
steps.description: Build an evidence map linking claims to supporting and contradicting evidence across sources.
steps.system_prompt_template: Return exactly {"sections":[{"heading":"Findings","claims":[{"claim_text":"The study reports a lower score","evidence":[{"evidence_id":"e0001","relation":"supports"}]}]}]}. Use only supplied evidence IDs, include at least one supporting reference per factual claim, and use relation supports or contradicts. Do not infer full-paper evidence from abstracts.

steps.name: Grounding Verification
steps.description: Verify that all synthesized claims are grounded in the original source material.
steps.system_prompt_template: Return exactly {"checks":[{"claim_id":"c0001","status":"supported","reason":"The cited excerpt states this result"}]} with exactly one check per supplied claim ID. Status must be supported, unverified, or contradicted. Assess each claim only against its supplied original source quotes.

steps.name: Synthesis Report Export
steps.description: Export the evidence synthesis as a structured report with evidence map visualization data.
